The build hit a timeout (exit 124) — likely still compiling Mathlib/SystemE from scratch. Lake builds are incremental, so re-running resumes. I'll redirect to a log file so partial progress is inspectable even if it's killed again, and try fetching the prebuilt Mathlib cache first to avoid compiling it from source.

<<<RUN cwd=LeanEuclidF>>>
source ~/.venvs/euclid/bin/activate && (lake exe cache get 2>/dev/null || true) && lake build Book3.Prop11.Main > /tmp/p11build.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT=$?"; tail -80 /tmp/p11build.log
<<<END>>>
